name: Click-100k
notes: Sources named by the card: ShowUI (web and desktop), AutoGUI, PC-Agent-E, WaveUI, OS-Atlas, UGround, PixMo Points, SeeClick, UI-Vision, a Jedi spreadsheet subset and frames from professional-application tutorial videos labelled with Claude 4 Sonnet (the card says 85 videos, the release README 80+). Each source was capped at 50k instances, and noisy or trivial samples were removed with OmniParser and grounding-model filters. The card says SeeClick, PixMo and UGround samples were excluded during RL training, so the training subset is smaller than the release. The release declares no data license, and the upstream sources keep their own terms. The training config names the dataset mlfoundations/clicks-100k, a spelling that differs from this Hub ID. Parquet files were not downloaded.
summary: 101,314 screenshot–instruction pairs with target boxes for click grounding, filtered from public GUI grounding sets and tutorial-video frames, packaged with EasyR1 point-prediction prompts.
